Implement these operations together because each uses the same actor/target authorization, revision, shared confirmations and BEGIN IMMEDIATE recheck with atomic People event. Do not implement reset-link issuance until the complete reset lifecycle in T4. Nobody acts on Owner or self; only Owner changes any role or acts on Admin. tasks.title: Reset and change passwords while rejecting stale sign-in and account writes atomically
tasks.spec: Repository: console, password/credential slice of Behavior and Order of work; Required behavior 3, 7-8, 11, 16-17, 19 and 21; Acceptance evidence 2 rows 20-22 and 27, remaining account/reset routes of 3, reset cases of 4a/4b, 5, ALL of 5a, applicable events/scans of 8, password/reset pages of 11 and completed 12; credential/CSRF/replay/reset Counterexamples and Security impact. Build the entire team reset-link lifecycle and own-password flow together with verified-hash sign-in rotation and guarded #563 writes; these share the credential/session transaction boundary and deterministic gated fakes. Team reset links are digest-only, valid 86400000 ms, issuer/target-role-bound, replaced on reissue, once; redemption revokes all target sessions and other unused links, keeps TOTP/recovery codes and starts no session. Include owner-recovery-kind redemption in the common reset logic for T5, clearing factors and recording owner.recover only for that kind. Use the public ordering of section 3 and shared link primitives: anonymous CSRF, a: token, invalid-link-first replay precedence and revalidation after hash. Own password uses recheckPassword, s: token, compare-and-set on session and H0, ends other sessions and writes its People event; pending reset link stays valid. Sign-in rotates/deletes/inserts in one verified-hash transaction and returns counted 401 with no session cookie if reset/removal made credentials stale. Add CredentialGuard and the new replaceRecoveryCodesFor, savePendingAuthenticatorFor and deleteOtherSessionsFor functions without changing the unguarded APIs/tests; switch all three routes to guarded writes and exact 409 answers with no leaked codes. Authenticator setup race uses action=new, not start. Cover full/enrol guards, session/hash changed or present and retain second-factor commit behavior. Complete real startup wiring tests for both link routes, notices, metrics, docs and browser cases alongside implementation.
